text: Wife: 'We need to talk.' Me: 'I wasn't even home.'
Opening the electric bill like it's a surprise party
Boss said 'quick call' at 4:55 on a Friday
Mom just added me to another family WhatsApp group
Doctor said 'less carbs.' I heard 'never again.'
Teen: 'Dad, can I ask something?' Me: 'How much?'
My retirement fund said hi. It's $12.
